description: Execute a command with {shell} and return its output. Use it for builds, tests, git and other programs, not to read, search or edit files. Every call starts in the working directory, so cd does not carry over to the next call.

description.description: Short title of what the command does, in a few words.

timeout.description: Milliseconds before the command is stopped, up to 600000. Default 120000.

run_in_background.description: Run it in the background with no timeout and return a job id at once.
